app.name: Service-Arb
state.noAccess.title: No access to the Service-Arb panel
state.noAccess.body: Your EV account signed in, but it has no role on the service_arb allocation. Ask an admin of that allocation to grant you operator or admin in the EV cabinet (Access tab), then reload.
state.unavailable.title: Sign-in service unavailable
state.unavailable.body: Try again in a minute. You are still signed in.
state.csrf: The page is out of date. Reload it and repeat the action.
state.forbidden: Your role may not do this.
state.signedOut.title: Signed out
state.signedOut.body: The session on this device is closed.
funnel.daily.title: By day · site
funnel.daily.pending: Site visits and contact intents will appear once PostHog is connected.
funnel.daily.mapsPending: Google Maps impressions and actions will appear once Google Business Profile is connected.
funnel.edge.body: Days and leads are counted differently; the step between them can only be estimated.
funnel.leads.title: By lead · panel
funnel.empty.body: Pick a longer period or another brand.
leads.title: Leads
leads.empty.filtered: Nothing matches these filters. Reset them, or log a call that came in.
leads.empty.none: Leads from the sites and calls you log appear here.
card.title: Lead
card.name: Name
card.noPii: Nothing the customer left is visible to you.
call.question: How did the call end?
call.attemptFailed: The call attempt was not recorded.
payment.title: Payment
payment.invalid: Enter amounts like 95 or 95.50; the commission cannot exceed the bill.
create.title: Incoming call
create.description: A call that bypassed the form becomes a lead.
places.title: Locations
places.window: Leads of the last {days} days. A share is a percent from {min} leads on; below that, “n of m”.
places.empty: No leads in the last 30 days
places.empty.body: A location appears here with its first lead.
sources.title: Sources
sources.revoke.title: Revoke {key}?
sources.revoke.body: Events signed with this key will be refused from now on. This cannot be undone; a new key has to be added instead.
sources.secret.title: Secret for {key}
sources.secret.body: Shown once. Put it in the source's secret store now; it cannot be shown again.
sources.empty.body: Add a key for each site or import that sends events to the panel.
more.title: More
experiments.title: Experiments
experiments.how: Each variant against the control, in percentage points, with its {confidence}% interval. A comparison needs {min} views in each arm; while the interval includes zero, there is not enough data. Contact is a lead, a call or a WhatsApp tap.
experiments.insufficient.small_sample: not enough data: too few views
experiments.insufficient.interval_includ: not enough data: interval includes zero
experiments.empty.body: An experiment appears once a landing shows its variants and PostHog counts the views. Pick a longer period or another brand.
experiments.pending: Experiments will appear once PostHog is connected and imported.
placeSettings.description: What the site shows for this point. An empty field keeps the site's own value.
placeSettings.phone.hint: International format, e.g. +33612345678. Empty: the site's own number.
placeSettings.phone.notE164: This does not look like +<country code><number>; the server may refuse it.
placeSettings.hours.empty: No hours here: the site uses its own.
placeSettings.hours.sameTime: Opens and closes at the same time.
placeSettings.hours.overnight: Closes after midnight, on the next day.
placeSettings.area.empty: No communes here: the site uses its own area.
placeSettings.saved: Saved. Live on the site within ~10 min.
placeSettings.conflict.title: Changed by someone else
placeSettings.conflict.body: Someone saved this place after you opened it. Reload to see their version; your edits here will be lost.
placeSettings.invalid: The server refused some fields; see the reasons below.
placeSettings.readOnly: Only an admin can change site data.
placeSettings.never: Never set from the panel: the site shows its own data.
placeSettings.kept: Kept as they are (not edited here): {fields}
placeSettings.withdrawn.body: Withdrawn: the site answers 404 for this point.
placeSettings.preview.title: What the site shows now
placeSettings.preview.open: Open now ({time} local): the call comes first.
placeSettings.preview.closed: Closed now ({time} local): the callback form and WhatsApp come first.
placeSettings.preview.unknown: The hours are the site's own, which the panel does not see, so it cannot tell whether the point is open now. Shown in the open-hours order.
placeSettings.preview.siteOwn: the site's own number, if it has one
placeSettings.history.empty: No changes from the panel yet.
placeSettings.history.revert.title: Revert this change?
placeSettings.history.revert.body: What was there before it becomes current again; the revert is itself recorded as a change. Live on the site within ~10 min.
placeSettings.history.reverted: Reverted. Live on the site within ~10 min.
placeSettings.withdraw.title: Withdraw {slug}?
placeSettings.withdraw.body: Within ~10 min the site answers 404 for this point: its page and contacts disappear for visitors. The data and history stay; restoring brings the page back.
placeSettings.withdraw.done: Withdrawn. The site answers 404 for this point within ~10 min.
placeSettings.restore.title: Restore {slug}?
placeSettings.restore.body: Within ~10 min the site serves this point's page again.
placeSettings.restore.done: Restored. Back on the site within ~10 min.
addPlace.title: Add a place by hand
addPlace.description: For a point no lead or visit has named yet. Brand and slug as the site's config has them.
addPlace.slug.hint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _, as in the site's address.
addPlace.exists: {brand} · {slug} is registered already: open its card instead.
live.status.live.hint: Changes by others appear here as they happen.
live.status.reconnecting.hint: The live connection dropped; the panel is getting it back. What is on screen may be a little behind.
live.status.offline.hint: No live connection: the panel re-reads the screen every minute instead.
session.devSignIn.hint: This backend signs people in without concierge. It is for local work only.
placeSettings.stale.title: Saved by someone else meanwhile
placeSettings.stale.body: {by} saved this place at {at}. Your edits are still here, but saving them would overwrite that change, so it is refused — load the fresh data to go on.
